title: 2026 West Africa dams: Nigeria-labelled published reference points within supplied SCMP display catchments
source: Kouassi et al. (2026), West Africa Dams and Reservoirs Dataset, bonndata, University of Bonn
processing: Publisher CSV Country field equals Nigeria/NGA/NG, Long_X and Lat_Y interpreted as WGS84 geographic coordinates only after verifying original .prj; Shapely polygon covers source point in one of 20 supplied simplified SCMP GeoJSON polygons. No administrative assignment, surveyed location or duplicate-entity review performed.
limitations: These counts indicate compiled, published source point intersections, not individually verified dams, dam existence/operation, current reservoir capacity, exhaustive inventory or independently surveyed coordinates. Zero means no match in this source, not absence of infrastructure. Source points may be incomplete or spatially uncertain; catchment polygons are simplified display derivatives.
